# Copilot Instructions — PAI Harness

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for full project context, key files, specs, and workflow.

## Essential commands

- `bun test` — run all tests (structure, spec compliance, schema canary, scaffold conformity)
- Review `gates/` — orchestrator, schema, brief-assembler enforce quality mechanically
- Review `specs/` — each spec has YAML frontmatter with `testable: true/false`

## Issue tracker

Issues are tracked on **hornjason/pai-config**, not this repo.
